name: AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL_
description: AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL contains information about installments for an invoice. AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL_ is the audit table for AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the invoice referenced in payment schedule.

columns.name: HELD_BY
columns.description: User who placed or requested the hold.

columns.description: Date on which the hold was placed.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of assignment. Possible values are ASSIGNED, STANDING_OFFER, and UNSUBSCRIBED. ASSIGNED represents the supplier assigned to the campaign, STANDING_OFFER represents that the supplier has accepted the standing offer, and UNSUBSCRIBED represents that the supplier has unsubscribed from the campaign.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_NAME
